create_agent_instance: create an Agent instance with num_actions, obs_spec, and a net_factory Haiku module
initialize_agent_params: initialize the agent parameters using initial_params with an RNG key
get_initial_state: get the agent initial state for a given batch size using initial_state
step_agent_action: step the agent forward with a timestep and state to sample an action via multinomial
unroll_agent_trajectory: unroll the agent along a trajectory to get policy logits and values
